newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers steady in modest trade.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers steady in modest trade.

text.p: Singapore bunkers were steady in modest trading on Tuesday as sellers geared up to off-load supplies amid softening swap prices, traders said.
They said 380-cst sellers offered at $106/$107 per tonne and 180-cst at around $109-$111.
"The paper market is a bit weaker. Some people might take the chance to sell at a slightly lower prices," a supplier said.

Sellers failed to widen the 180/380 cst spread to $4.00 per tonne from $3.00 as shipowners held back their 180-cst purchases. MDO and gas oil were indicated at $168 and $178 per tonne, respectively. -- Singapore Newsroom (65-870 3093)
